# pg-connection-pooler

> PostgreSQL transaction-mode connection pooler speaking the v3 wire protocol, with md5 client auth, bounded wait queues and server reuse at idle ReadyForQuery Rust crate `trysac-pg-connection-pooler`, library `pg_connection_pooler`, MIT licensed,
> Rust >= 1.88 (edition 2024), standard library only.
